source_clause: PRACC6.) The Profile feature will have a button defaulted in the status bar (but status bar can be customized to remove it). The button icon will change depending on which profile is logged in.
leaf_desc_037: PRACC6.) The Profile feature will have a button defaulted in the status bar (but status bar can be customized to remove it). The button icon will change depending on which profile is logged in. (image: %E5%9C%96%E7%89%87_1610819271.png) (image: %E5%9C%96%E7%89%87_19752790.png)
reasoning: 驗證目標：4.6（PRACC6）—— Profile 按鈕預設存在於狀態列，且其圖示隨作用中之 profile 改變。關鍵情境條件：兩 profile 之 avatar 不同，否則「圖示改變」無從觀察。為什麼這樣切：兩個斷言（預設存在／圖示隨 profile 變）為同一節之兩個結果，依 §5.7 併為一條之兩段。**ER3 以「與步驟 1 所讀不同」表述** —— 圖示之具體內容屬 4.6.1，本條只斷言其**改變**。

tcs.tc_title: Profile button present in the status bar by default
tcs.test_item: Profile button present in the status bar by default
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The status bar is at its default configuration
2. Two Driver Profiles exist with different avatars
3. The Welcome popup setting is off for both Driver Profiles
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the status bar and record the Profile button icon
2. Activate the other Driver Profile
3. Read the status bar button and check that its icon changed with the active Profile
tcs.expected_result:
1. A Profile button is present in the status bar and its icon is recorded
2. The other Driver Profile is active
3. The Profile button icon differs from the icon recorded in step 1
tcs.priority_basis: 狀態列按鈕之預設存在與其圖示變化；呈現層
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: 條文之括號句（狀態列可被客製以移除該按鈕）為**另一觸發**，其行為由 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-016`（4.6.3）承擔；本條驗預設狀態。圖示之**內容**（avatar／首字母）屬 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-014`（4.6.1）。**X-1（切換 profile 觸發 5.3.1 之 PU0580）**：本條驗狀態列按鈕之圖示隨現用 profile 改變；popup 會遮住狀態列。故 pre-condition 指定 Welcome popup 設定為關閉 ——該設定之關閉途徑見 6.3.2（`SWE1-HMI-PROF-051`），**為合法之車輛狀態，非測試用旁路**。
